source.summary: GitHub Actions ‘Embedder footprint’ runs for PR #338 (branch fix/313-unused-import-link-check at head b71ce46530121b02463c760fa346843b18e74126 — the #313 change (check every declared import at instantiation, used or not; commit 8ac78cf) merged with current main 726fdd964b5b6c5dd264397d8616154cb7a9b242 (PR #337); ubuntu-24.04, Rust 1.96.0): workflow_dispatch runs 45541235250, 45541244272 and 45541252709 against the branch and pull-request run 45541235451, which built the same tree, produced byte-identical sizes for every gated series
source.derivation: Re-baseline for PR #338 (#313, check every declared import at instantiation, used or not). Attribution was isolated by measuring current main alone three times (workflow_dispatch runs 45541261935, 45541270512 and 45541278948 on main at 726fdd964b5b6c5dd264397d8616154cb7a9b242; all three runs pass the gate). The main control reproduces the checked-in baseline exactly on all 32 gated series, so no part of the gate failure is main-side staleness. This PR's own delta against the main control is confined to the three configurations that link telomere-component (component, wasi, wasi-threads): in release, stripped file +2,560 B in component and wasi and +2,544 B in wasi-threads, stripped .text +2,096 B in each; in release-size, stripped file +2,048 B / stripped .text +1,840 B in component, and +1,648 B / +1,440 B in wasi and wasi-threads. Every other configuration is byte-identical to main in both profiles. The change itself is confined to telomere-component's runtime (check_imports_satisfied in runtime/env.rs, called from the two component-instance creation sites so a declared import that nothing references is still link-checked at instantiation); the core library is untouched. Against the checked-in baseline the gate therefore tripped on 12 of the 32 gated series. Against the original #164 baseline, the largest cumulative growth is now the release component stripped file series at +9.96% (2,433,656 B to 2,675,928 B); the release core-nosimd stripped file series is unchanged at +9.83% (1,275,448 B to 1,400,840 B). The core-aot configuration, added by PR #267 after the #164 baseline, is not part of the cumulative comparison. Run-to-run spread was 0 B for every gated series across the three branch samples and across the three main samples.
